free_tier.stated: 超级会员 is sold by the month. The vendor's own table gives the non-member column (普通用户) a 10GB cloud drive, 10-day recycle bin, 5 GB per month of cloud-drive high-speed download ('非会员：5GB/月') and a speed table entry of 586 KB/s against 15.8 MB/s for 超级会员.
free_tier.notes: The vendor page vip.xunlei.com/vip_service/supervip_info/dist/ was read on 2026-11-03.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. 云添加 accepts up to 500 files per submission and the drive is 10 to 12 TB, so the practical unit is a task, not a byte.

retention.stated: 云盘回收站: the vendor table lists 保留60天 (年费超级会员), 保留30天 (超级会员), 保留15天 (白金会员) and 保留10天 (普通用户). Files not deleted are kept while the membership runs.

egress.terms: The vendor page states the cloud-drive high-speed download volume by member level: 超级会员等级1-3：2TB/月、超级会员等级4-6：6TB/月，超级会员等级7-10：12TB/月、白金会员：1TB/月、非会员：5GB/月. A third-party article quoting the vendor's promotion states 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回. When the volume is used up the task runs at normal speed.
egress.free_allowance: 5 GB/month of 云盘高速下载 for a non-member; 10 TB/month is the third-party figure for the annual membership

record.interface_detail: Vendor client only. 云添加 takes magnet, ed2k and http(s) links, and third-party tools drive it through the user's own endpoints rather than a published API. No public API was found on any page read.
record.tooling: Official Windows, macOS, Android and iOS clients; the 云添加 queue accepts magnet/ed2k/http in batch. No rclone backend exists for 迅雷云盘.
record.chaining: Retrieval is a monthly allowance inside the membership, set by the member level: 超级会员等级1-3：2TB/月、超级会员等级4-6：6TB/月，超级会员等级7-10：12TB/月、白金会员：1TB/月、非会员：5GB/月 on the vendor page (a third-party article states 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回). The card price is in price_per_tb_month.

limits.value: 云盘高速下载 per month, vendor page: 超级会员等级1-3：2TB/月、超级会员等级4-6：6TB/月，超级会员等级7-10：12TB/月、白金会员：1TB/月、非会员：5GB/月; a third-party article states 月度支持10TB云盘高速取回 and 文件上传流量为240G/天、1T/月
1000 次云添加/天, 500 files per submission
10 并行下载; the vendor speed table puts 超级会员 at 15.8 MB/s against 586 KB/s un-membered

identity_cost.detail: The login offers a phone number plus 微信/QQ QR login. No email-only path was found and the login page at i.xunlei.com returned an empty document to every reader tried, so whether a non-mainland number is accepted was not established. Phone is the gate; the country rule is unverified.

record.reliability_note: Offline downloading and acceleration features are consolidated under member acceleration, making cloud retrieval dependent on active subscription status.
record.confidence_note: Prices come from IT之家 and 新浪 quoting the vendor's promotion pages and from the 会员省 index (read 2026-11-03). The vendor's privilege page vip.xunlei.com/vip_service/supervip_info/dist/ was read on 2026-11-03 and gives the allowances by level. The login page was not readable; one purchase and one 云添加 would raise this to measured.

record.price_per_tb_month: CNY 9.93/month at the 30-month price (¥298/30mo); CNY 22/month on 连续包年
record.notes: Drive size by source: IT之家 and 新浪 say 12 TB, the 会员省 price index says 10 TB, and the vendor privilege table lists 12T (年费超级会员), 6T (超级会员), 3T (白金会员) and 10GB (普通用户). 迅雷's 离线 function no longer exists as a standalone product; the cloud-add queue is what replaced it.
record.binding_note: 10 TB/month of high-speed retrieval is the first wall at 1 TiB/month only if uploads are also counted; the real constraint is that retrieval is inside a membership, not sold per byte, so the quota binds before any shaping does.

record.chaining: Paid SVIP membership gives 5T of space for the length of the subscription; the SVIP price is not on the captured first-party page.
record.reliability_note: A legacy 2T free allowance was cut to 100G from 2020-10-15 for accounts not logged in between 2018-12-25 and 2020-10-15; accounts logged in at least once keep 2T, and paid accounts are unaffected.
record.confidence_note: Re-read on 2026-11-03: https://eyun.baidu.com/content/120945/ (new accounts normally get 5GB base free storage; the same page's FAQ gives 2TB as the usual base space), https://pan.baidu.com/buy/memberCenter (SVIP includes 5T), https://eyun.baidu.com/knowledge/bb8114b593e34901b2f38926a60f8f0c.html and https://eyun.baidu.com/content/862622/ (a mainland China phone number is the main registration condition), https://passport.baidu.com/v2/?reg (registration form asks for a phone number) and, third party, https://www.ithome.com/0/511/746.htm (2020 cut of the 2T allowance to 100G for accounts not logged in between 2018-12-25 and 2020-10-15). Confidence stays reported: the 5GB figure is contradicted on its own page and the legacy-cut claim rests on the third-party page.
